question: In a game with a range of influence of 1, Alex is seated to the left of Rob and Carissa to the right of Rob. If Rob leaves the game, does Carissa enter Alex's range of influence at the start of the next turn?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: Carissa enters Alex's range of influence at the start of the next turn.
expected.answer: In a game with a range of influence of 1, Alex is seated to the left of Rob, and Carissa is seated to the right of Rob. Carissa is not in Alex’s range of influence. If Rob leaves the game, Carissa will enter Alex’s range of influence at the start of the next turn.
